# LOL梗 (LOLgeng)

> LOLgeng (www.lolgeng.com) collects funny internet memes from China and around the world, one interactive page per meme. Homepages: Chinese at https://www.lolgeng.com/ and English at https://www.lolgeng.com/en/.

## Memes

- [疯狂星期四 Crazy Thursday](https://www.lolgeng.com/event): China's weekly "Crazy Thursday / V me 50" KFC meme, with a countdown to the next Thursday and animated effects (page in Chinese).
- [疯狂星期四文案大全](https://www.lolgeng.com/event/wenan): 100+ original Crazy Thursday "V me 50" copy lines in Chinese, grouped by style (identity twist, romance, fake science, classical, CEO romance, official notice, office worker, one-liners, comebacks), each with a copy button.
- [91 · 老色批鉴定](https://www.lolgeng.com/91): Prank page for people searching "91" (slang for an adult site): instead of anything adult, it shows a cartoon portrait of a "老色批" (old perv) with a certification stamp. No adult content.

## Site

- [About](https://www.lolgeng.com/about): What the site is and what each meme page contains.
- [Privacy](https://www.lolgeng.com/privacy): What data the site collects (hashed IPs for counters, a language cookie) and ad cookie notice.
